extraction.Name: James Poor Horse
extraction.Recorded patent: Yes, filed for record at Perry, Noble Co. Okla., by Allottee
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Still owns all of the land
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: No sale; 40 acres mortgaged for $500.00; date of redemption expired
extraction.Occupation/Income: By farming own land. No contributions, income approximately $476.00 per year from inherited lands.
extraction.NOTES: Patent receipted: yes. Patent number/file reference: 61391. Has wife and four children dependent upon him for support. No funds. Good health. No contributions from Government or State or County. No sale for debt or taxes. Both parties mentioned are of Ponca City, Okla. Notarized November 20, 1928, in Kay County, State of Oklahoma. Commission expires Aug. 3rd 1951.
